Card Q&A.a: Yes. Blocking causes the attack target to be switched, so the effect activates.
Card Q&A.q: If I attack my opponent using a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards and my opponent blocks, does this card's inherited effect activate?

Effect: ＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.)
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When this Digimon's attack target is switched, this Digimon gets +3000 DP for the turn.
